children: H100 Group AB ("H100" or the “Company”) is joining Ark Labs as co-host of the Capital Sessions, the opening programme of Ark Labs' Arkade Day 2026 at LAC Lugano on 21 October.

Arkade Day brings together executives, capital allocators, developers and product teams from across Bitcoin infrastructure and financial products. The Capital Sessions open the day with the questions that decide whether a corporate Bitcoin strategy holds up in practice: Where bitcoin sits on the balance sheet, how it is secured, and how options strategies are used around it. The afternoon Builder Lab turns to what is being built; wallets, applications, assets and liquidity; and what still needs solving.
Sander Andersen, Executive Chairman of H100, opens the morning with remarks on Bitcoin capital allocation in Europe.
Bitcoin is moving to the centre of capital markets, and the next stage of adoption will be won by making it easy to own

I am looking forward to talking about how bitcoin can be packaged into traditional equity structures. Most institutional capital is set up to buy shares, not to hold and safeguard bitcoin itself, and a listed company lets those investors back a management team that spends all of its time growing bitcoin per share. That is how a great deal of traditional capital will find its way to bitcoin, and there is a lot of it still to come

H100 Group AB is a technology company operating in the health and longevity sector, combined with an active Bitcoin Treasury Strategy. The company is the first and largest listed Bitcoin treasury company in the Nordics, with 3,506 bitcoin held on its balance sheet.
H100’s technology business is focused on supporting providers of health and lifestyle services through AI-powered automation, digital growth tools, and integrated platform solutions.
The company is listed on NGM Nordic SME. For more information, visit www.h100.com
